resolution: Alignment requirement satisfied: the iso authoring pane drives the SAME building model every other tool does, verified end to end. The F2 build-mode renderer was extracted to shared editors/build modules (req_0391) so walls draw with ONE renderer; the pane snaps with the shared resolveSnapTarget, validates with GAME_BUILD.placed.validatePlacement, and commits the SAME piecePlaced WorldEvent to the SAME worldStream via the cart's existing commitBuildEvent — so a piece placed in the iso pane stands in F2 and in the game, no second representation. Storey height (METERS_PER_LEVEL) sources from HMSC_SCALE.storyHeightMeters, which IS the F2 build wall = one storey, so floors line up with stacked walls. Change a piece/snap/storey once, it changes everywhere.
